name: LLM Council
description: Karpathy-style LLM Council: Opus, Sonnet and Gemini Flash persona sub-agents answer in parallel, anonymously peer-review and rank each other, and an Opus chairman synthesizes the final answer.
author: eskwisit
safetyNotes: Declarative skill only. agent.prompt.inject is used solely to index the LLM Council skill for the agent's Skill tool; main.js does nothing at runtime. The bundled scripts/council.py is run by the agent through its normal shell tool: it anonymizes answers, parses rankings and writes a report in the workspace run directory, and on request copies the five council sub-agent definitions (subagents/*.md) to ~/.agents/subagents, the only place PI-Desktop loads sub-agents from. It makes no network calls.
